messages.subject: Fisherman beanie issue
messages.text:
Hello,

We recently received our order from November and we noticed that the beanies are too small for adults. We all tried them at the shop and they do not seem to fit most adult heads. Are they meant to be for kids? They are not as stretchy as it seemed.

Is there a possibility to exchange them for other products? 

Thanks a lot and have a great day,

messages.subject: Re: Fisherman beanie issue
messages.text:
Hi Carolina,

No need to ship the beanies back, you can keep them, donate them, or sell them as-is at the shop.

Sorry for the very late reply on this last message, this winter was an intense stretch for us and a simple confirmation like yours shouldn't have waited this long. The phone sleeves were sent your way to make up for the beanie sizing, so everything should be wrapped up on your end.

If anything didn't arrive as expected, just let me know and I'll sort it out.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com

Petit mot en toute transparence : ce message a été préparé par un nouveau système de réponse assisté par intelligence artificielle, présentement en rodage. S'il y a le moindre problème, il est possible de me joindre directement au 581-982-5857 pour régler le dossier rapidement.
